key_takeaways: February splits by hemisphere: southern summer in Queenstown and Tasmania, the cooler Gulf months, Alpine winter, and the Maldives and Thailand's Andaman coast outside their wet seasons.
The Maldives and Phuket top our ranking for a beach wedding, and Madeira, at number 10, is the European pick for February without snow.
Gulf dates need a Ramadan check first: our Dubai guide places Ramadan and Eid in February and March in 2027, and the dates move earlier each year.
We would hold Bali and Fiji for another month, as Smartraveller puts February inside Indonesia's usual wet season and Fiji's cyclone season.
Plan 12 to 18 months out, lock in rooms early around Valentine's week, and have the covered or indoor option confirmed for your date.

faq.q: Is February a good time for a wedding?
faq.a: Yes, if you match the place to the hemisphere: summer in Queenstown and Tasmania, cooler months in the Gulf, winter in the Swiss Alps, and the Maldives and Thailand outside their wet seasons. Bali and Fiji are better in another month.

faq.q: What are the best places to get married in February for a beach wedding?
faq.a: The Maldives and Phuket lead our list, with Ras Al Khaimah and Mexico's Riviera Maya and Los Cabos further down. For an outdoor wedding closer to home, Queenstown and Tasmania are in summer, with no long-haul flight for guests.

faq.q: Does Ramadan affect a February wedding in Dubai, Ras Al Khaimah or Doha?
faq.a: It can. Our Dubai best-time guide notes that Ramadan and Eid fall in February and March in 2027. Check the exact dates for your year, and ask your venue early what changes for events during the month.

faq.q: How far ahead should we book a February wedding abroad?
faq.a: We would plan from 12 to 18 months out, the range our Ras Al Khaimah guide recommends, and earlier for Valentine's week or a large room block. Our Dubai guide says 10 to 12 months is commonly advised for peak winter dates.

faq.q: Can we marry in Bali or Fiji in February?
faq.a: You can, but we would wait. Our Bali page points to April to October for outdoor ceremonies, and our Fiji page points to May to October for the most settled weather. If February is fixed, look at the Maldives or Phuket instead.
